## Description

Combines deep variational autoencoders with Markov state-space transition networks to forecast non-stationary intraday volume distribution curves for execution optimization.

## Where it may fit

VWAP execution optimization, intraday volume forecasting on earnings or macro release days.

## Vehicles

Algorithmic Execution Platforms, High-Frequency Trading Desks.

## Required data

Intraday 1-minute and 5-minute volume profiles, historical order flow, event calendar markers.

## Caveats

Variational inference training requires reparameterization trick stability checks under extreme volume spikes.
